extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create or find a Wikipedia article (new or deleted-page troubleshooting)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia page (troubleshooting a missing page title), including account requirements, search/redirect checks, deletion-log checks, and technical/cache delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "The Late Late Show with Stephen Colbert" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check alternative capitalizations (titles are case sensitive except for the first character) and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check what links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can show whether an article exists under a different name or whether redirects should be created.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created page visibility / database delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an article exists under a different capitalization, consider adding a redirect from this title to the correct title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted page troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons in the log to determine whether the title can be recreated or needs modification; follow deletion guidance before re-submitting.
